title: connect-request/1
description: Since 1.5.0. The body of POST /api/v1/connect: a one-time connect code from the Admin, and a name for the repo. The request has no Authorization header: the code is the proof. It has no contract field, like ack-request/1. A good code gives connect/1: a new key for the code's project.

code.description: The connect code the Admin made: 6 characters of 23456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ, shown as XXX-XXX. The dash is optional and any case is fine (K7P4XM, K7P-4XM, k7p-4xm).

label.description: The name the Admin sees under Connected repos: the repo folder name, " · ", and the BA's git user.name (just the folder when git has no name), e.g. "acme-docs · Vadim".
